model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant latent tokens between baseline Mistral-0.2 and the same model fine-tuned on various specialty datasets. The horizontal axis represents the six clinical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, listed from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "Log-probability," spans from 0 to 55 on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 5, and displays values in units of (unspecified). Each specialty has two bars: one representing the baseline model and one representing the fine-tuned model. The baseline model is represented by light gray bars, while the fine-tuned models are represented by colored bars (blue for Cardio, green for Gastro, orange for Infect, purple for Neuro, pink for Obstetrics, and cyan for Pediatrics). The shortest bar, belonging to the baseline model for Pediatrics, has a value of approximately 32.0, while the tallest bar, belonging to the fine-tuned model for Cardio, reaches approximately 51.8. The bars are sorted by specialty, and the bars representing the fine-tuned models are visually emphasized with a darker hue compared to the base model.
